Post 1
📈 ASX 200 closed at 8,806.70, up 1.00% or 87.00 points — a 20-day high. Tech surged 5.62% while defensives sold off. Growth is back in charge. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
🔺 IT +5.62%, Materials +3.18%, Health Care +2.49% led Friday's rally. Financials -0.52%, Consumer Staples -0.53% lagged. Risk-on rotation, plain and simple. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 3
WBT surged 17.07% to AUD 2.880, leading the ASX 200. Defence names ran hard too — EOS +10.07%, DRO +9.86%. The market is pricing in a very specific kind of future. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD 6,036.30/oz. Silver AUD 83.09/oz. Materials sector up 3.18% on the day — precious metals momentum is doing the heavy lifting for miners right now. #gold #metals #mining #ASX

Post 5
Gold holding above AUD 6,000/oz is the line to watch. Does Materials extend its 3.18% Friday gain next week, or does profit-taking hit? What's your call — fade or follow? #gold #ASX #ausbiz
